empty_strip.observed: a healthy fixture observation renders no strip rows (zero intervention nodes in the AX tree).

blocked_observation_row.observed: an unconfigured disconnected window renders exactly one Desktop-local row, 'Observation unavailable — Reconnect', with no Runtime issue/severity vocabulary and no destructive action.

reconnect_action.observed: activating Reconnect produces the honest local result 'Reconnect requested — this window has no authorized observation to subscribe to.'; the condition remains unresolved and no canonical state is touched.

settled_stop_is_not_a_row.observed: after an explicit Request Stop the fixture reaches CANCELED/STOPPED; the strip shows no row for the settled stop state, matching the recorded rule that settled states are not rows.

ordering_dedupe_task_scope.observed: the fixture offers no Runtime severity, no multi-kind condition set and only one Task, so ordering, dedupe/grouping and A→B scope cannot be produced natively; the 20 ui-model and 14 desktop-gpui intervention tests carry that evidence.

unavailable_reference_rows.observed: a static fixture never removes a viewed or compare reference, so the unavailable/missing-reference rows cannot be created natively.

attention_stop_rows.observed: the fixture settles the stop within the observation window, so an awaiting-receipt or unknown-stop attention row did not persist long enough to observe.
